description: Portable catalog of the 12 original agents (names, responsibilities and classification recovered from the original agent definitions and rewritten portably). 8 primary specialists; code-reviewer and payment-integration optional; two redundant agents superseded by primaries.

agents.responsibilities: Read-only evidence-based analysis of a codebase: architecture, dependencies, data flows, technical debt.
agents.rationale: Foundation of the analysis, planning, prompt, implementation flow; no write access needed.

agents.responsibilities: Turns verified analysis and requirements into implementation plans, acceptance criteria and implementation prompts. Planning only.
Converts verified reports and requirements into concise executable prompts with acceptance criteria. Prompt preparation only.
agents.rationale: Prompt preparation is a distinct read-only step.

agents.responsibilities: Live website and UI analysis: responsive design, accessibility, UX, with explicit evidence types.
agents.rationale: Observation-only audit of a running site; no repository changes.

agents.responsibilities: Frontend implementation: React, Next.js, TypeScript, accessibility, responsive UI, UI testing.
agents.rationale: Core client-side implementer; also covers the former frontend-developer scope.

agents.responsibilities: Backend implementation: Node.js, TypeScript, APIs, Supabase, PostgreSQL, authn/authz, integrations, backend testing.
agents.rationale: Core server-side implementer; also covers the former backend-architect scope.

agents.responsibilities: Kotlin Multiplatform implementation: Android/iOS shared code, Compose Multiplatform, Swift interop, coroutines, persistence, mobile builds.
End-to-end QA: Playwright and browser automation, regression, accessibility, reproducible test reports.
agents.rationale: Independent evidence-based testing of running flows.

agents.responsibilities: Independent code review: quality, security vulnerabilities, error handling, tests, dependencies, performance.
agents.rationale: Independent of the eight execution specialists, strictly read-only, activated when a diff needs review.

agents.responsibilities: Payment integration: Stripe/PayPal/Square, checkout, subscriptions, webhooks, PCI, idempotency.
agents.rationale: Specialized domain used only for payment work; not part of the core eight.

agents.responsibilities: Backend architecture and API design: API paradigm selection, service boundaries, schemas, event-driven design, observability.
agents.rationale: Its design guidance (API design, schema design, authn/authz, observability) is covered by backend-expert, with planning handled by technical-planner; no unique contract or write scope.

agents.responsibilities: Multi-framework frontend development (React, Vue, Angular) with tooling and accessibility defaults.
agents.rationale: Generic framework checklist with no unique contract; implementation, accessibility and performance covered by frontend-expert. Vue/Angular-specific work should be requested through frontend-expert and its task contract.
